summary.text: Rick Outman is a Republican member of the Michigan Senate representing District 33, which since January 1, 2023 includes all of Montcalm and Newaygo counties and parts of Ionia, Kent, Lake, Muskegon and Ottawa counties.
His Senate biography says he was first elected to the Senate in 2018 after serving in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Outman is a graduate of Lakeview Community Schools and earned a Bachelor of Science in teaching from Grand Valley State University, with teaching degrees in biology and Spanish.
He is a veteran of the U.S. Army and the Michigan National Guard's 1073rd Support Maintenance Company, and he has worked as the owner of Outman Excavating.
Outman was elected to the Michigan House of Representatives in 2010 and represented the 70th District until term limits ended his service in 2016, chairing the Michigan Capitol Committee.
In 2018 he was elected to represent the 33rd Senate District.

He is a member of the Montcalm County Farm Bureau, the Hough-Pontius #3701 VFW post and other organizations, and he lives in Six Lakes with his wife, Kris; they have three children and three grandchildren.
